# Tradetron Brain

> Verified knowledge base for building Tradetron algo strategies with Zerodha Kite
> market data. The corrections ledger is the only authoritative source; every other
> file is subordinate to it and may contain stale claims. The canonical path is `01_PLAN/00_CORRECTIONS_LEDGER.md`.

Read AGENTS.md before writing anything. Claims are tagged [V] verified,
[O] official doc, [I] inferred, [U] unverified. Files under 90-archive are
historical evidence containing known errors, not current truth.

## Canonical

- [Corrections ledger](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rishabh-Satawat/tradetron-brain/feat/foundation-cleanup/01_PLAN/00_CORRECTIONS_LEDGER.md): verified exchange parameters, errors already made, standing rules. Overrides everything. The root file is historical.
- [Task register](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rishabh-Satawat/tradetron-brain/main/01_TASK_REGISTER.md): live task state, owners, blockers.
- [Agent rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rishabh-Satawat/tradetron-brain/main/AGENTS.md): permissions, evidence tags, prohibitions.

## Optional

- [Document template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rishabh-Satawat/tradetron-brain/main/_TEMPLATE.md): front matter contract for new files.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rishabh-Satawat/tradetron-brain/main/CHANGELOG.md)
